newsletter.subject: Harbor Line opens to Fenwick on March 14
newsletter.text:
The Harbor Line extension to Fenwick opens on March 14, adding six stations and cutting the ride downtown to 22 minutes.
The flat fare stays at $2.75. Weekend service will run every 10 minutes.
Station map (PDF): https://metronotes.example/map.pdf
